    Players & access

    People sign in with their own Claude account. What they can do depends on how you share this page with them.

    CoachEditor

    Everything: plays, squads, graphics, team of the week, scoring and this page.

    PlayerContributor

    Views the playbook and plays only. Team of the week and graphics stay with coaches.

    Everyone elseLink, as Viewer

    Live scores and results, on ERGS Live.

    1. Open the Share menu at the top of this page.
    2. Invite each coach by email as Editor, and each player by email as Contributor.
    3. To let parents follow live scores, turn on the link and set it to Viewer. They need to be signed in to a free Claude account.

    Upload the fixtures list as a photo, PDF or spreadsheet saved as CSV, or paste it below. One fixture per line works best, for example Sat 7 Feb 2026 | 1st XV | Banbridge Academy | H | 10:30 | Schools’ Bowl.
